title: Pure Abyss Actor
summary: Abyss Actor cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Abyss Actors are DARK Fiend Pendulum Monsters paired with Abyss Script Spells that have a regular effect when activated and a massive bonus effect when destroyed by the opponent while Set.

summary.title: Starters
points: Abyss Actors' Dress Rehearsal activates at the start of Main Phase 1 to search both an Abyss Actor Pendulum Monster and an Abyss Script Spell at once.
Abyss Actor - Mellow Madonna pays 1000 LP in the Pendulum Zone to search any Abyss Actor Pendulum Monster, locking you into Abyss Actor Pendulum Monsters for the rest of the turn.
Abyss Actor - Extras Special Summons itself from the Pendulum Zone when the opponent controls a monster, or tributes itself on the field to place an Abyss Actor Pendulum in your Scale.

summary.title: Opening: Dress Rehearsal + Any Pendulum
steps: Activate Abyss Actors' Dress Rehearsal to add Abyss Actor - Mellow Madonna and Abyss Script - Rise of the Abyss King or Abysstainment.
Place a Pendulum in your Scale and Link Summon Abyss Actor - Hyper Director using a Pendulum Monster on the field.
Hyper Director Special Summons the card in your Pendulum Zone and places another Abyss Actor Pendulum from the Deck or face-up Extra Deck into the Scale.

Link Summon Abyss Actor - Super Producer, which destroys a face-up card you control during either Main Phase to place Abyss Playhouse - Fantastic Theater from the Deck or an Abyss Actor Pendulum in your Scale.

summary.title: Fantastic Theater & Abyss Scripts
summary.text: Abyss Playhouse - Fantastic Theater reveals an Abyss Actor and an Abyss Script in hand to search a different Abyss Script every turn. While you control a Pendulum Summoned Abyss Actor, Fantastic Theater rewrites the first monster effect the opponent activates each turn into 'Destroy 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls', forcing the opponent to blow up your Set Abyss Scripts and trigger their Waking the Dragon-style effects.

summary.title: Control & Payoff
points: Abyss Actor - Superstar prevents Spell/Trap responses when Normal or Special Summoned and Sets an Abyss Script directly from the Deck every turn.

Abyss Actor - Liberty Dramatist Special Summons itself to the opponent's field when an attack is declared, then destroys itself in battle to force the opponent to destroy a Set Abyss Script from your Deck.
Abyss Script - Abysstainment Special Summons any number of Abyss Actor monsters from the Deck when destroyed while Set, while Opening Ceremony draws until you have 5 cards in hand.

Abyss Script - Rise of the Abyss King destroys face-up cards on the field up to your Attack Position Abyss Actors, and cannot be responded to while you control a Level 7 or higher Abyss Actor like Superstar or Evil Heel.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Locks
points: Abyss Script - Romantic Terror is a Quick-Play that bounces an Abyss Actor Pendulum to summon another from the face-up Extra Deck and Sets a used Script when destroyed while Set.
Abyss Actors' Curtain Call adds face-up Abyss Actor Pendulums from the Extra Deck to the hand up to the number of Abyss Scripts activated that turn, then Special Summons Abyss Actors from the hand.
Mellow Madonna, Hyper Director and Extras lock you into summoning or Pendulum Summoning Abyss Actor monsters after their effects resolve, so sequence generic Extra Deck plays before using them.
